name: Delton Cables Limited
summary: Delton Cables Limited is primarily involved in the fabrication and commercialization of electrical wires, cables, and various switchgear products. The company functions as a crucial supplier to major industries including power, telecommunications, railways, steel, and mining, serving clients both within India and internationally. Established in 1948 by Ram Kumar Gupta, its corporate headquarters are located in Faridabad, India.
